summary: Backend only. ON ARRIVAL THE BACKEND WAS DOWN (502 on every route): IndentationError at server.py:4121 (a stray 'raise HTTPException' left in voice_feedback). I fixed it, then ran 118 pytest tests (the 85 old ones + 33 new in test_iteration2_fixes.py): 107 passed (90.7%). Verified working: POST /api/businesses/register with state/zip_code/postalCode (postalCode is mapped to zip_code and persisted); business/auth/login and register return a session_token that works on /auth/me and the business endpoints; login with a missing password_hash returns 401; the /api/auth/* verification routes exist; /api/voice/* and /api/personalization/* return 200 and /api/api/* is gone. I also FIXED: BSON-datetime fromisoformat crashes (they broke POST /discounts, coupon redeem, GET /business/subscription/status and group deals) and the UserReward missing reward_value (first redeem returned 500). Still broken: business_owner user_type is rejected by require_business_auth, so business-auth businesses can't create discounts; account takeover through /business/auth/register; verification endpoints don't match the frontend contract; verify flag fields are wrong; the frontend still reads access_token; 5 endpoints still swallow HTTPException into 500. MOCKED: emails are print-only and create-payment-intent is a local stub.

critical.issue: FIXED BY T1: IndentationError at line 4121 in /voice/feedback (left over from removing get_current_user). Uvicorn could not import server.py, so the backend was down and returned 502. Removed the stray line.

Account takeover. If owner_email belongs to an existing user, the endpoint reuses that account without checking the password and returns a valid session_token for it. Verified: registering with the victim's email and the attacker's password gives a session whose /auth/me is the victim. For passwordless (Google) users it also sets the attacker's password. It also overwrites user_type to 'business_owner', so an existing admin or customer silently changes role. Fix: if the user exists and has a password_hash, require bcrypt.checkpw; never set a password on a passwordless/Google account without verification; don't downgrade user_type.

Users created via /business/auth/register get user_type 'business_owner', but require_business_auth (server.py:835) only allows ['business','admin']. Every business registered through the dedicated business flow gets 403 'Business access required' and can never create discounts. Fix: add 'business_owner' to the allowed list, or create the user as 'business'.

FIXED BY T1: datetime.fromisoformat() was called on Mongo-native datetimes (trial_end, current_period_end, expires_at) and raised a TypeError (500). Added an _as_dt() helper. Also excluded _id from the plan in subscription/status. Discount create and redeem now pass.

FIXED BY T1: check_and_award_badges built UserReward without the required reward_value field. A redemption that earned a badge returned 500 after the coupon_usage row was already inserted (partial write). Added reward_value=0.

The routes now exist and work with the backend's own contract. They are still unusable from the frontend (verification.tsx): send-email-verification is sent with NO body and returns 422 (the backend requires a dict body with email; it should default to user.email). send-phone-verification sends phone as a QUERY param and returns 422. verify-email and verify-phone send {code}, but the backend reads 'verification_code' and returns 400 'Verification code is required'.

They set users.email_verified / phone_verified, but the User model and /auth/me use is_email_verified / is_phone_verified. Verification never shows up in /auth/me (verified: false after a successful verify).

minor.issue: Still return 500 wrapping a 403/404 (e.g. 'Demand prediction error: 403: Access denied'). Add 'except HTTPException: raise'.
Still 500: list() used on an AsyncIOMotorCursor. Use await cursor.to_list(None).
Use sync pymongo MongoClient (blocks the event loop) and a hardcoded db name 'coupon_app' (self.client.coupon_app) instead of os.environ['DB_NAME'].
FIXED BY T1: missing await on Motor calls (find_one returned a coroutine, so insights would crash once a profile existed; insert_one was never awaited, so feedback was not stored).

integration_issues.issue: business-auth-login.tsx:47 and business-auth-register.tsx:197 still store result.access_token, which is now undefined (the backend returns session_token). They also store it under 'auth_token', while business-mobile-dashboard.tsx and the other screens read 'session_token'. Business users are not authenticated after login.
business-register.tsx:219 calls /api/businesses/register with NO Authorization header, so it gets 401 (the endpoint requires auth).
The request body/params in verification.tsx don't match the backend (see backend_issues).

action_items: SECURITY: /business/auth/register must verify the password of an existing owner_email account (bcrypt.checkpw) before issuing a session. Don't attach a password to Google accounts or change an existing user's user_type.
Allow user_type 'business_owner' in require_business_auth (server.py:835), or register owners as 'business'. Currently business-auth users get 403 on POST /discounts.

Verification endpoints: default email to user.email when there is no body; accept phone from the query string or body; accept 'code' as an alias of 'verification_code'. Use Optional Body models instead of 'request: dict'.
verify-email/verify-phone: set is_email_verified / is_phone_verified (the User model's field names).
Frontend business-auth-login.tsx and business-auth-register.tsx: store result.session_token under the 'session_token' key.
Add 'except HTTPException: raise' to pricing/demand-prediction, pricing/analytics, mobile/device/status, mobile/security/attestation (and the other ~40 similar handlers).
Fix receipt-insights to use the async to_list. Switch voice_ai.py and personalization_engine.py to Motor and DB_NAME from env.
Run the server.py syntax check (python -m py_compile) after edits: the last change took the whole backend down.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is about 6200 lines; split it into routers.
The hardcoded Emergent LLM key at server.py:58 and the JWT_SECRET default should come from env.
Verification endpoints take 'request: dict' (unvalidated). Use Pydantic models.
Session tokens are a uuid4 inserted with no cleanup or limit. Every login creates a new session row.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py: removed the stray raise (IndentationError) in /voice/feedback; added await to voice_feedback.insert_one and user_profiles.find_one; added the _as_dt() helper replacing 6 fromisoformat calls on Mongo datetimes; excluded _id from the plan in /business/subscription/status; added reward_value=0 to the badge UserReward
/app/backend/tests/test_dealwiz_core_api.py (session_token instead of access_token; passwordless-user login now expects 200)

success_rate.backend: 90.7% (107/118) after T1 fixes; iteration-2 targeted fixes: the 5 requested fixes are verified, but 6 related gaps are found (security, role, contract)

seed_data_creation: test_* users and sessions are seeded directly in Mongo by conftest.py and cleaned up (users test_*, businesses TEST_*). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is still MISSING.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && python -m pytest tests -q. Auth = Bearer session_token from db.user_sessions. Note: /business/auth/register with the conftest 'owner' or 'customer' email flips their user_type to business_owner (a test-order side effect that reflects the real bug).
rca_of_issue: Backend down: the main agent replaced the 'if not user:' guard in voice_feedback but left its indented 'raise' body, which is an IndentationError at import. Discount/subscription 500s: the models declare datetime fields, Motor stores them as BSON datetimes, and the code called datetime.fromisoformat on them. 403 for business-auth owners: user_type 'business_owner' is missing from the require_business_auth allow-list.
